note: Our gain on a position (distributions + NAV - invested) split by the company's bridge, by hand. The bridges are fixture 19's: A is its case 1 (250, 65, 30 of 345; revenue 120, margin 130), B its case 2 (58.33..., 21.66...67, -10 of 70; no revenue), Z its case 4 (total 0). Case 1: gain 2,000,000 + 14,900,000 - 10,000,000 = 6,900,000 = 20,000 x 345, so EBITDA 5,000,000, multiple 1,300,000, debt 600,000, revenue 2,400,000, margin 2,600,000. Case 2: gain 500,000 + 4,500,000 - 4,000,000 = 1,000,000: EBITDA 1,000,000 x 250 / 345 = 724,637.68115942028985507246 (20 places), multiple 1,000,000 x 65 / 345 = 188,405.79710144927536231884, debt takes the remainder 86,956.52173913043478260870; revenue 1,000,000 x 120 / 345 = 347,826.08695652173913043478, margin the remainder of the EBITDA part, 376,811.59420289855072463768. Case 3: a loss of 690,000 = -2,000 x 345 splits the same way with the sign of the loss. Case 4: gain 700,000 over bridge B: 700,000 x 58.33333333333333333333 / 70 = 583,333.3333333333333333, 700,000 x 21.66666666666666666667 / 70 = 216,666.6666666666666667, remainder -100,000. Case 5: a company whose equity value did not change has no shares, so nothing is split. Case 6: no invested capital means no gain and nothing to split.
